citationText: BVT, gfu, GfK, “Consumer Electronics Marktindex Deutschland,” 2005-2013, http://www.bvt-ev.de/bvt_cm/der_markt/cemix.php.First presented at IBC 2014, Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 11-15 September 2014. This paper is published here by kind permission of the IBC. Copyright © IBC. Jörg Huschke is a master researcher in the radio protocol research group at Ericsson GmbH, Germany. He is with Ericsson Research at the Ericsson Eurolab since 1997. He has been task leader in European research projects DRiVE and WINNER, where he led the work on estimating the spectrum requirements for the ITU IMT-2000 and IMT.advanced family of systems towards WRC-07. Since 2008, he has been working towards 3GPP standardization of MBMS for LTE and on its performance evaluation. Furthermore, he is active in the EBU Strategic Program Cooperating Terrestrial Networks (mobile subgroup). Since 2016 he is also leading the radio interface team in the German research project KoI on evolved LTE and 5G based wireless communication in factory automation. He received the diploma degree in electrical engineering from the Georg-Simon-Ohm University of Applied Sciences in Nuremberg, Germany in 1993.
